name: WatchSync
overview: Sync watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD)
description: Automatically synchronizes watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD). When a movie is watched in 4K, the HD version is also marked as watched (and vice versa). Uses IMDB, TMDB and TVDB identifiers to match media between libraries.

versions.changelog: Initial release with automatic sync and scheduled task

name: JellyTag-Plus
overview: Overlays quality badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language, collections) on media posters and thumbnails
description: JellyTag-Plus automatically overlays quality badges on your media posters and thumbnails. Supports per-library badge type controls, resolution, HDR, video codec, audio, alphabetized language flags with undetermined fallback, VOST indicator, and multiple regex-matched collection badges with custom images.

versions.changelog: Fix interference with Maintainerr and other artwork uploads: only process GET image requests, passing uploads, deletions, and other HTTP methods directly to Jellyfin. Existing image rendering and cache optimizations are preserved. Restart Jellyfin after updating, then rerun Maintainerr overlays.

Reduce uncached image request overhead by batching image-cache and badge-status index writes every 30 seconds. Index changes are available immediately in memory, with background persistence, retry on failure, and a final flush on normal shutdown. Existing image caches remain compatible.

Speed up cached images by removing per-request warmer ledger I/O, batching learned-profile saves, and checking exact cache hits first. Speed up new renders by releasing render slots before cache writes/client transfers, reusing parsed SVGs, and avoiding image-buffer copies. Existing image caches remain compatible.

name: Task Grid
overview: Shows Jellyfin scheduled tasks on a weekly hour grid
description: Task Grid displays Jellyfin scheduled tasks on a Monday-first weekly grid with hour columns, color coding, optional conflict highlighting, refresh support, and red warnings for tasks most recently aborted by server shutdown.

versions.changelog: Save resized visual block lengths immediately when dragging finishes, persist grid zoom while navigating away and back to Task Grid, and add a synced top horizontal scrollbar above the grid.

name: Version Notifier
overview: Quiet 4K availability notifications for movies and episodes.
description: Notifies viewers when an accessible 4K alternative is available.

versions.changelog: Remove notification header; display only the configured message.
Fix Android TV notifications when supported commands are not advertised.
Improve Android TV compatibility with playback sessions that omit media source IDs.

Initial release: accessible 4K alternative notifications for movies and episodes, grouped versions and separate libraries, configurable delay and message, and playback cancellation/duplicate protection.

name: Artist Pruner
overview: Preview and reversibly correct extra album-artist credits
description: Testing release. Dry-run by default; optional full mode with validated recovery points and restore. Corrects eligible surplus album-artist credits without deleting artist records or music files. Locks affected metadata until restored or manually unlocked.

versions.changelog: Testing release: dry-run plus reversible full-mode album-credit corrections, validated backups, and administrator restore. No artist or file deletion.
